text: In dialogue, a character’s word choice can reveal more than a description: give each speaker a distinctive phrase or rhythm, then remove their names and see if you can tell them apart.
Crows can recognise human faces and remember people who have threatened them; their sharp social memory is a reminder of how adaptable wildlife can be.
